t: You're at numbers 1 and 2 Robert Street, a building in Westminster. It was designed by members of the Adam family: Robert Adam, his brother James, and their father William. Robert was a Scottish neoclassical architect and furniture designer, and James was his business partner, though often overshadowed by him. William was the foremost architect in Scotland of his day, best known for Hopetoun House near Edinburgh and Duff House in Banff. After William died, Robert and his older brother John took on the family business.
